title_en: The Greatest Messenger (peace be upon him and his family) in Umayyad Heritage and Islamic Heritage - Episode 2
summary: Part of the 'Debates in Beliefs' series, this lecture by Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari discusses the depiction and status of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) across Umayyad and Islamic traditions.
